Several sessions (≈6–10 h, not counting the Oramond Quest tasks)

The beggars of Rathleton are acting strange and the magistrate {npc:Ezebeth} wants to know why. You follow the Beggar King's trail to the abandoned sewers, discover ancient ruins, defeat the boss {creature:The Ravager}, investigate the death of the transporter Quandon in a séance and finish off {creature:Death Priest Shargon}. At the end you receive the {wiki:Glooth Engineer Outfits|Glooth Engineer Outfits}, several items and access to the {wiki:Oramond Fury Dungeon}.
The citizens of Rathleton need help investigating the strange behaviour of the city's beggars.
No known minimum level; **recommended level 150+**. To cross the cave of Demons and Grim Reapers in the Abandoned Sewers a team of at least 2 players of level **220+** is recommended.
Team of **4 or 5 players** for the two bosses (the Ravager's lever needs 4; Shargon only accepts 4 or 5).
**Commoner** rank in Rathleton (see {wiki:Rathleton Quest}) for the last two missions.
At least **one free vote** with the Rathleton magistrate.

{wiki:Oramond Quest} tasks you will need (you can do them beforehand): Taking The Rot Out (for {npc:Chavis}, optional), The Ancient Sewers (for {npc:Jacob}/{npc:Elliott}), Probing (for {npc:Doubleday}), The Powder of the Stars (for {npc:Barnabas Dee} — keep at least 15 pollen in the Quest Log) and Rathleton Turnip Party or Sabotage (for {npc:Terrence}).
or Magic Rope / equivalent, useful in the sewers
given by Jondrin in the middle of the quest
picked by you in the hydra cave (another player's pollen doesn't count)
or other area attacks, for Shargon's minions
Lots of supplies: you have to walk back the same way through the Demon cave
{wiki:Glooth Engineer Outfits|Glooth Engineer Outfit} (base) — given by Ezebeth
Part 3: after repairing 20 valves, {npc:Jacob} or {npc:Elliott} gives you permission ({key:abandoned sewers}, {key:mission}, {key:ok}, {key:abandoned sewers}).
Part 8: {npc:Terrence} ({key:manway}, {key:effort}) lets you in after you do a mission against the minotaurs of the {wiki:Oramond Quest}. After the quest the access becomes permanent.
With the quest completed: {npc:Ezebeth} gives you the base outfit, needed for the addons.
Do the Oramond Quest tasks listed in the requirements first: you save several back-and-forth trips.
Don't hand in all of the Blue Pollen from The Powder of the Stars: you need to have **15 pollen** counted in the Quest Log for Barnabas Dee.
Against Death Priest Shargon **never** use runes that create fields on the ground, Magic Wall, Wild Growth or Sudden Death.

Rathleton is on the island of **Oramond**. In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You disembark at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on a small islet **west** of Oramond. Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a hill on the main island (with minotaurs). Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat: that boat's portal takes you to the other side of the water, near the city. From there head **north** to the main gate and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city (Upper Rathleton).
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
Path from the boat to Rathleton

Go to the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate} (on Rathleton Magistrate Plaza, floor 5) and talk to {npc:Ezebeth}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:assistance}, {key:strange}. She asks you to investigate what the beggars are up to.
Where to find Ezebeth in the Rathleton Magistrate

Leave Upper Rathleton by the south stairs and keep walking **west**. By the western stairs of the {wiki:Rathleton Workshop Quarter}, near the slime river, is {npc:A Beggar}. Say {key:hi}, {key:want}, {key:yes} and {key:palace}. He tells you to help Chavis and says the king lives in the caves under the junk yard.
A Beggar by the slime river, west of the Rathleton Workshop Quarter

{npc:Chavis} is in the poorhouse, directly **west** of A Beggar, near the west gate. Say {key:hi}, {key:food}, {key:roots}. In theory he asks you for 5 {item:Juicy Roots} picked by you on the western outskirts of the city (you hand them in with {key:food}), but **you can skip this part**: the Quest Log doesn't change and you can go straight to the Beggar King.
Chavis in the southwest, at the red "!"; the green "^" above leads to the city and the "^" on the right is the beggars' bridge
If you hand in roots, they must be picked by you; each bundle of 5 gives you one vote with the magistrate.

Go to the junk yard, a little **southeast** of Chavis and west-southwest of A Beggar. Go through the quest door and down one floor. The entrance and the poorhouse are marked on your map with a red exclamation mark.

Talk to {npc:The Beggar King}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:something}, {key:traces}, {key:abandoned sewers}. He says something is hunting the beggars in the sewers and tells you to talk to the Glooth Brothers.

The Glooth Brothers are {npc:Jacob} and {npc:Elliott}, both in the {wiki:Rathleton Sewers}; Jacob is the easier one. From the Beggar King's palace (ground floor), head **west** to the wall and climb the stairs onto the wall. Follow the wall **south** until it turns east; at the next exit there is a sewer grate. Go down through the grate and then down the stairs a little to the north. Jacob is in the room to the east.
From the palace: west to the wall, climb the stairs, head south and go down the next stairs; go east and down the grate
Follow the wall until you reach this sewer grate
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} to Jacob. You have to repair at least **20** loose generator pipes and valves (recognisable by the **black smoke**).
Explore the sewers and **use** 20 pipes/generators giving off black smoke.
There are lots of valves and generators near Jacob and on the floor below him

Go back to Jacob or Elliott (either one, whichever gave you the task). Say {key:abandoned sewers}, {key:mission}, {key:ok} and then {key:abandoned sewers} again to receive the permission. You have to say exactly *abandoned sewers* (he doesn't answer to *abandoned sewer*). To get back to the surface, do the route in reverse: climb the stairs and leave through the grate onto the wall.
1 vote with the magistrate + access to the Abandoned Sewers

The entrance is marked on your map: a little **west** of Jacob and one floor down. Walk west from Jacob, go down a floor and go through the quest door. Alternatively, follow the route in the picture from Rathleton.
Follow the path towards the X marks to reach the Abandoned Sewers
You find a connection to a cave with a jade floor full of {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers}. Cross it to the end and step on the strange carving.

Usually 2 Demons appear together with a few Grim Reapers and {creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles}. Go in a team of at least 2, level 220+, well stocked: you have to make the whole way back to get out.

Go back the same way: cross the jade cave again (the Demons and Grim Reapers may have respawned), go through the quest door and return to {npc:Jacob}'s sewers. Depending on the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} votes, there may be a {item:Slime Slide} in the **southwest** part of the dungeon, which takes you back to {wiki:Upper Rathleton}; the small room southeast of that Slime Slide works as a safe spot.
Go back to one of the Glooth Brothers and say {key:abandoned sewers} and {key:report}. He sends you to talk to the historian Barazbaz.
Go back to the magistrate building. {npc:Barazbaz} is **west** of the entrance. Say {key:hi} and {key:abandoned sewers}. He asks you for a vote to fund the archives.
{npc:Marvin} is a few steps to the **east**. Say {key:hi}, {key:funding}, {key:archives}, {key:1} and {key:yes} to put **ONE** vote on funding the historical archives.
Ask {npc:Barazbaz} about {key:abandoned sewers} again. He tells you about the catacombs and sends you to fetch a necrometer from magistrate Jondrin, upstairs.

Go up a floor and talk to {npc:Jondrin}: {key:hi}, {key:necrometer}, {key:yes}. If you haven't done the **Probing** task for {npc:Doubleday} yet (see {wiki:Oramond Quest}), he tells you to do it first.

Go back to the end of the Abandoned Sewers (the Demon cave). With the {item:Necrometer} you can now teleport across the magic tiles. To enter the next room you need a team of **4 players** to pull the lever. You enter the room of the first boss, {creature:The Ravager}.

When you enter, 4 {creature:Greater Canopic Jar|Greater Canopic Jars} spawn in the centre, healing the allies around them. The **knight** pulls the Ravager around the corners of the room. The other 3 players block the {creature:Elder Mummy|Elder Mummies} so they don't step on the lizard tiles, while destroying the 4 Greater Canopic Jars one by one.

If an Elder Mummy steps on a lizard tile, it heals itself and its allies. The Ravager also summons 8 {creature:Canopic Jar|Canopic Jars}, which heal nearby allies and disappear if the Ravager is far away.

With the 4 Greater Canopic Jars destroyed, focus on the boss. The knight goes to one of the corners, waits for the Ravager to summon as many Canopic Jars as possible (avoiding a trap) and then pulls it to an area **without lizard tiles**. You can also use {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growth Runes} and {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Wall Runes} to stop it from stepping on those tiles. Put all your damage into the Ravager.
Every second the Ravager spends on a lizard tile it recovers health. Don't pull it so far that its Canopic Jars disappear.

After you kill it, enter the **north** teleport (the south one takes you back). Open the **southeast** box for your reward. Then step on the switch in the **northwest** and open the box to get a book (the notebook). Leave through the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the **northeast** corner: you return to the 4 tiles.
Leave the Abandoned Sewers the normal way, or follow the dungeon **west** and then **north** to a {item:Slime Slide}, which takes you back to {wiki:Upper Rathleton}.
Talk to {npc:Barazbaz} and say {key:notebook}. He recognises the handwriting of a travelling friend of magistrate Sholley.
{npc:Sholley} is **two floors above** Barazbaz. You need the **Commoner** rank. Say {key:hi} and {key:friend}: her friend is called Harsin and lived at the inn (bed and breakfast).
Go to the inn just **west** of the city and ask {npc:Roswitha} about {key:harsin}. She says he moved with the help of a man called Quandon.
Quandon's house is just **southwest** of the inn, past a quest door. Go up the stairs: you only find his body.
Talk to {npc:Sholley} again about {key:quandon}. She marks the house of the medium Barnabas on your map.

{npc:Barnabas Dee} is two floors above {npc:Flint}, just west of the stairs up to the Rathleton Magistrate. Say {key:hi}, {key:seance}, {key:prepared}, {key:source} and {key:mission}. He needs 15 pollen.

Pick **15** {item:Blue Pollen} in the hydra cave **northwest** of the city (details in the The Powder of the Stars task of the {wiki:Oramond Quest}). You have to pick them yourself: another player's pollen doesn't count. The cave ({wiki:Oramond Hydra/Bog Raider Cave|Oramond Hydra/Bog Raider Cave}) is in the **west** of Oramond: go down through the hole at the marked spot. To leave, go up the same hole with the {item:Rope} and return to Rathleton to the **east**.
The way to the cave and back can be dangerous because of the Quara raids on the surface.
Go back to {npc:Barnabas Dee} and say {key:mission} and then {key:yes} to all the questions (5 times). He teleports you to a cave.

In the cave, get past the {creature:Murderous Ghost|Murderous Ghosts} and enter the next teleport. Talk to {npc:Quandons Ghost} ({key:hi}): he says he was killed by Death Priest Shargon and marks the hideout on your map. To get there you need {npc:Terrence}'s permission, south of the city.
TibiaWiki doesn't describe how to leave this cave (it is beneath Oramond). Bring a way back to the temple, for example a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}, in case you can't find the way back.

Talk to {npc:Terrence}, south of the city: {key:hi}, {key:manway}, {key:effort}. If you haven't fought the minotaurs yet, do at least one minotaur mission ({key:mission}): Rathleton Turnip Party or Sabotage (see {wiki:Oramond Quest}). Then come back and say {key:effort} again.
The Rathleton Turnip Party can be done very quickly: pick up the supply crate at this spot and use it on the floor below, to the east.
The door to the {wiki:Oramond Fury Dungeon} is **north** of Oramond's east bridge. Go down the ramp just north of the entrance (you have to go around the mountain).

Inside there are {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers} and {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons}.
Fight your way to the other side of the room, where there is a small room with **5 special tiles** and a lever. The team (4 or 5 players) stands on the tiles and pulls the lever.
Room with the 5 tiles and the lever
It only works with 4 or 5 players. If the team has more than 5, the rest can repeat the fight right afterwards.

Stay close to the teleport where you arrive. {creature:Death Priest Shargon} summons {creature:Lesser Death Minion|Lesser Death Minions} (they look like {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}): kill them **very quickly** with area attacks, for example {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes} every turn. If you don't kill them, they evolve into {creature:Greater Death Minion}, then {creature:Superior Death Minion} and finally {creature:Necromantic Energy}, which are much stronger.

**Do not use** runes that create fields on the ground (elemental walls and bombs), {item:Magic Wall Rune}, {item:Wild Growth Rune} or {item:Sudden Death Rune}. If you do, the boss disappears and several {creature:Death Reaper|Death Reapers} (similar to Grim Reapers) spawn, which also attack the shooters. If that happens, leave the room and try again right away.

After you kill it, leave through the **north** teleport. Open the {item:Treasure Chest (Ornamented)|Treasure Chest} in the centre of the room and leave the way you came in. That is: cross the big room again to the ramp and leave through the door north of Oramond's east bridge ({coord:33666,31924,7}).
Go back to {npc:Ezebeth}, in the east wing of the Rathleton Magistrate, and say {key:hi} and {key:outfit}.
To leave the island, go back the same way to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
Also known as the **Glooth Engineer Outfit Quest**.
After the quest you have permanent access to the {wiki:Oramond Fury Dungeon}.
